nodes.d: Quickly spin around while extending the sword out, dealing two hits of 80% weapon damage to all foes within 3m.
Successful heavy attacks grant you 30% empower for 5s. (Empower increases damage.)
The final attack in your light attack chain inflicts a 15% rend for 2s. (Rend reduces target's armor.)
An upward slice that deals 180% weapon damage. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Sword and shield critical strike chance increased by 10%.

Grants a bonus to Whirling Blade hits based on what equip load the player is: •Light - Inflicts target hit with 15% rend for 10s. •Medium - Increases stamina regen rate by 10% per hit for 4s. (Max 4 hits.) •Heavy - Inflicts target with 16% weaken for 6s. (Rend reduces target's armor.) (Weaken reduces target's outgoing damage.)
Successfully hitting with a heavy attack causes you to lose 1 debuff.
Upheaval hits against targets inflicted with crowd control (stun, root, slow) status effects deal 20% more base damage.
Move 33% faster while blocking.
When you block an attack, gain a stack of 3% empower for 5s. (Empower increases damage.) (Max 5 stacks.)
Leap forward, dealing 100% weapon damage.
Abilities deal 10% more base damage to slowed foes.
Whirling Blade reduces its own cooldown by 5% for each enemy hit.
If you hit a foe below 30% health, deal 50% more base damage.
On a successful hit with Upheaval, all other sword cooldowns are reduced by 20%. (Max 1 reduction per ability use.)
While health is full, deal 15% more base damage.
On critical, gain 15% haste for 5s. (Haste increases movement speed.)
On successful hit, inflict a 30% slow for 3s. (Slow reduces target's movement speed.)
While holding a sword, grant Empower to all group members, increasing their damage by 10%.

Deals 50% weapon damage, staggering and stunning foes in front of you for 2s. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your sword, this ability inflicts taunt for 6s to all enemies hit. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Grants an additional 15% physical armor.
Stamina damage is reduced by 15% when blocking a melee attack with a shield.
Shield Bash causes greatly increased threat and now deals 75% weapon damage.
Reduce base damage from all magical types by 10%.
Rush forward 5m, staggering and pushing back foes. This attack deals 100% weapon damage. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Stamina damage is reduced by 15% when blocking a ranged attack with a shield.

Grants a bonus based on what shield type is equipped: •Round Shield - Hitting a target will increase the duration of all debuffs on them by 5%. (1s Cooldown). •Kite Shield - When you block with a shield, all sword and shield cooldowns are reduced by 1%. •Tower Shield - Being hit or blocking a hit will extend the duration of all buffs on self by 5%. (1s Cooldown).
On a successful hit, all enemies within 5m are inflicted by 20% weaken for 10s. (Weaken reduces target's outgoing damage.)
When you block an attack, gain 20% fortify for 5s. (Fortify increases armor.)

For 8s, reduce the incoming base damage from attackers by 30% and reduce the attacker's stamina damage while blocking by 20%. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your sword, activating this ability inflicts taunt for 8s to all enemies within 8m. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
The third attack in your light attack chain deals 15% more base damage, and if in heavy equip load, generates additional threat.
Gain 15 stamina when hitting a target with Shield Bash or Shield Rush.

Grants a bonus to Defender's Resolve based on what shield type is equipped: •Round Shield - Base damage increased by 20% while Defender's Resolve is active. •Kite Shield - Potency of slows on you are reduced by 30% while Defender's Resolve is active. •Tower Shield - Gain 20% Fortify while Defender's Resolve is active.

Grants a bonus to Shield Bash hits based on what shield type is equipped: •Round Shield - Increase the critical hit chance of your next hit within 5s by 50%. •Kite Shield - Cleanse 1 debuff from yourself. •Tower Shield - Shield Bash's stun duration is increased by 1s.
On a successful hit, all enemies within 5m of you are slowed by 30% for 4s. (Slow reduces target's movement speed.)
All incoming healing and regeneration is increased by 10%.
When Defender's Resolve ends, heal for 30% of your base health.
While blocking, reduce damage to all allies within 4m by 30%. (Cooldown 1s.) (This effect cannot be dispelled.)
Strike the ground with your war hammer, dealing 90% weapon damage and knocking down your target. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Increase armor penetration by 10% for all war hammer basic attacks.
Gain empower on heavy attacks, increasing damage by 20% for 4s.
All war hammer abilities apply exhaust, slowing target's stamina regeneration by 20% for 5s. (Does not stack.)

An overhead leaping attack that crushes down on enemies, dealing 190% weapon damage. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your war hammer, hits with this ability inflict taunt for 4s. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Adds grit to war hammer heavy attacks. Also grants 12% damage reduction while grit is active. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
On a successful hit, gain fortify, increasing armor by 20% for 7s.
Increases Mighty Gavel base damage by 20% to targets below 50% health.
Increase heavy attack base damage by 15% against targets under 30% health.
A powerful swing that penetrates 35% of the target's armor and deals 160% weapon damage.
Expands the range of Wrecking Ball to a 1.5m radius.
Heavy attacks that hit reduce cooldowns by 7%. (Max 5 reductions per attack.)
Increase stamina damage done by Mighty Gavel by 25%.
Adds grit to Armor Breaker. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Deal 35% extra damage for 1s after taking damage.
After a successful Mighty Gavel attack, gain haste, increasing player's movement speed by 20% for 3s.
Increase Armor Breaker base damage by 25% against targets above 70% health.
Armor Breaker inflicts 30% rend for 10s. (Rend reduces target's armor.)

Mighty Gavel now has grit, its critical hit chance is increased by 20%, and hits will reduce all other war hammer cooldowns by 10%. (Cooldown reduction only occurs once per attack.) (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)

Slam your war hammer into the ground, causing a 3m radius earthquake that deals 60% weapon damage, staggering and stunning all impacted targets for 2s. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your war hammer, this ability inflicts taunt for 6s to all enemies hit. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Increase armor by 20% if surrounded by 2 or more enemies within 3m.

nodes.n: I Can Do This All Day
nodes.d: Reduce stamina consumption by 30% when blocking melee attacks.
The trauma of the attack causes weaken, decreasing the damage dealt from the target's attacks by 10% for 10s.
A wide swing that knocks back targets 4m and deals 100% weapon damage. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Reduce damage taken by 10% while sprinting.
Reduce war hammer cooldowns by 7% when using light attacks against targets with an active debuff. (Max 5 reductions per attack.)
After hitting a target with an active debuff, gain haste, increasing movement speed by 15% for 3s.
Hitting a target with Clear Out grants fortify, increasing armor by 20% for 4s to all friendlies within 6m.
Deal 15% increased base damage against targets affected by war hammer debuffs.
A powerful ground strike that erupts a linear wave of energy in front of the player, dealing 70% weapon damage to all targets in its path.
Expands the range Shockwave to a 4m radius.
Clear Out's cooldown is reduced by 5% per enemy hit with the ability.
Heal for 35% of damage dealt when using a Crowd Crusher ability.
Path of Destiny now staggers all targets in its path.
After 2 light attacks with the war hammer, debuff durations on player are reduced by 25%. (Cooldown 5s.)
Using Clear Out on a target grants haste, increasing movement speed by 20% for 4s.
Ability cooldown reduced by 5% for each enemy hit with Path of Destiny. (Max 5 enemies.)
Whenever a target is hit by an ability, they are slowed by 20% for 4s.

After completing any ability in the Onslaught tree, enter onslaught stance for 10s. Onslaught stance has the following properties: •Outgoing Damage Increased: 15% •Damage Taken Increased: 15% •Quick Charge: Heavy attacks charge 50% faster if you have 10 stamina to consume (Entering defiant stance or switching weapons will immediately end onslaught stance.)
Increases base damage by 15% when attacking foes that are above 90% health.
Slash 3 times in a quick sequence. First Hit: 110% weapon damage. Second Hit: 130% weapon damage. Third Hit: 160% weapon damage. Enter onslaught stance when the third attack of this ability ends.
Charged heavy attacks have 15% armor penetration.

Dash through foes while spinning and apply a 20% slow for 4s on hit. First Hit: 110% weapon damage. Second Hit: 120% weapon damage. (This attack cannot backstab.) Enter onslaught stance when this ability ends.
Gain grit while performing Crosscut. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) In defiant stance, gain stun immunity while performing Crosscut.
Gain a 20% haste for 5s when hitting a target with a Onslaught tree ability. (This effect has a 10s cooldown.)
After gaining onslaught stance, your next attack within 5s has a 100% increased critical hit chance.
Enter onslaught stance by hitting with a charged heavy attack. (This effect occurs even if the attack is blocked but will not renew onslaught stance if it is already active.)
Base damage of the final strike is increased by 50% if the target is below 50% health. In onslaught stance, this threshold is increased to 75% instead.
Become energized by landing a critical hit and regain 5 stamina and 5% base health per second for 5s. (This effect has a 10s cooldown.)

Swing up in a brutal arc, staggering your target, dealing 50% weapon damage and applying 2 stacks of 5% rend for 10s. (Max 3 stacks.) In onslaught stance apply 1 additional rend. Enter onslaught stance when the upward arc of this ability ends. (Rend reduces target's armor.)
Gain 10% empower for 10s after hitting a target with Relentless Rush.
Critical hit chance is increased by 10% when attacking foes with an active debuff.
Add a followup attack that deals 140% weapon damage by activating the skill again or using a basic attack.
In onslaught stance, Relentless Rush applies root to targets it hits for 0.5s. In defiant stance, Relentless Rush heals for 15% of its damage. (Max 5 hits.)
Reduces ability cooldown by 50% when you kill a foe. (This effect has a 5s cooldown.)
After dodging, gain a 10% empower for the next 3 hits within 10s. (This effect only occurs when in combat.) Attacks empowered by this effect restore 10 stamina on hit.
The first attack applies disease which reduces incoming healing by 20% and outgoing healing by 10% for 10s. The followup attack strikes all foes within a 3m radius.
Hitting foes reduces greatsword cooldowns: •Light attack: 2% •Charged heavy attack: 10% (Cooldown reduction only occurs once per attack.)

After completing any ability in the Defiance tree, enter defiant stance for 10s. Defiant stance has the following properties: •Damage Taken Reduced: -15% •Outgoing Damage Reduced: -15% •Guard Point: Block incoming attacks while charging heavy attacks (Entering onslaught stance or switching weapons will immediately end defiant stance.)
Hitting with the final attack of the greatsword chain reduces the duration of debuffs on you by 10%. (This effect has a 5s cooldown.)
If you are hit while at full health, reduce the damage taken by 20% then gain a 20% fortify for 3s. (This effect has a 20s cooldown.)

Stab the ground and send out a shockwave with a 4m radius that deals 120% weapon damage. Gain 10% fortify for 7s for each foe hit. (Max 3 stacks.) This ability generates 200% threat and has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Enter defiant stance when this ability ends. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your greatsword, this ability inflicts taunt for 8s to all enemies hit. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
After gaining defiant stance you will also gain fortify, increasing your armor by 25% for the next hit taken within 5s. (Does not apply to damage from debuffs.)
For each greatsword buff on you, base damage increases by 3%. (Max 4 buffs.)

Block for 2s while reducing block stamina damage taken by 90%, then unleash a counterattack that strikes all foes within a 4m radius. •No Blocks: 80% weapon damage. •1 Block: 80% weapon damage and staggers. •2 Blocks: 80% weapon damage and staggers longer. •3 Blocks: 80% weapon damage and causes a knockback. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Reactivate this ability or use basic attack to counterattack earlier. Enter defiant stance when the counterattack of this ability ends. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your greatsword, activating this ability inflicts taunt for 8s to all enemies within 8m. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Cleanse 2 debuffs after using Roaring Rupture.

Stab your greatsword forward to impale your foes, then pull back to rip the blade out. Restores 20 stamina on each hit. First Hit: 40% weapon damage and staggers. Second Hit: 120% weapon damage and pulls target 1.5m towards you. This ability generates 150% threat. Enter defiant stance after the second attack of this ability ends.
Charged heavy attacks have grit and inflict bleeding for 6s dealing 5% weapon damage every second. (Max 5 stacks.)
Counter attacks inflict bleeding for 6s for each power level. Each stack deals 5% weapon damage every second. (Max 5 stacks.)
Blocking for 2s causes you to enter defiant stance. (You must be in combat for this effect to activate. This effect will not renew defiant stance if it is already active.)

If the first strike of Steadfast Strike hits, you are healed for 50% weapon damage. In defiant stance, the first strike also inflicts 2 stacks of bleeding for 6s which deals 5% weapon damage every second. (Max 5 stacks.)
You can now block 100% of the ranged attack damage while using a greatsword. Additionally, you also reduce the stamina damage from all attacks while blocking by 10%.

Counter attack crit chance is increased by 25%. In onslaught stance, the counter attack gains an additional 25% critical hit chance. In defiant stance, the counter attack heals for 20% of its damage. (Max 5 hits.)
The shockwave applies a 10% weaken for 10s on hit. Additionally, after a successful hit become uninterruptible for 5s.
If the second strike of Steadfast Strike hits, reduce the cooldown of all other greatsword abilities by 20%.

Reduce the attackers stamina damage dealt by 50% when blocking attacks just after raising your guard or with guard point. Blocking attacks within this window inflicts a 5% rend for 10s against melee attackers. (Max 3 stacks.)
In defiant stance, the shockwave pushes foes outward 3m. In onslaught stance, the shockwave pulls foes 3m towards you.
Heal for 5% of the damage from attacks. Attacking within 3s of blocking an attack heals for 15% of the damage dealt instead.
Hitting at least 2 targets with a great axe light attack grants 20% haste for 3s. (Haste increases movement speed.)
Light attacks with your great axe give you a stack of empower, increasing damage by 5% for 5s. (Max 3 stacks.)
A powerful overhead attack dealing 200% weapon damage. Base damage increased by 50% to foes below 50% health.
When you critical hit with a great axe, heal yourself for 10% of the damage done.

Extend your axe 5m, pulling foes to you and dealing 80% weapon damage and staggering struck foes. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your great axe, this ability inflicts taunt for 4s when it hits. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Increase armor penetration of great axe attacks by 10% against foes below 50% health.
Execute gains grit during its attack. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)

Charge 15m and deal 120% weapon damage when you reach a target. Press basic attack to stop charging and attack early. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Critical damage increased by 10%.
Reap range is now 8m.
Execute has a 100% critical chance against foes below 30% health.
Charge now deals 120% / 130% / 140% weapon damage based on time spent charging.
Whenever your attacks are blocked, gain a stack of Empower dealing 15% damage for 10s. (Max 1 stacks.)
Heal yourself for 30% of damage done by Reap.
Great axe attacks against foes below 30% health have 15% increased critical chance.
During Charge you may press block to execute a swing attack, dealing 140% / 150% / 165% weapon damage based on time spent charging.
After pulling, perform a spin attack dealing 115% weapon damage.
Great axe attacks against foes below 30% health heal you for 10% of damage done.
When looking at a foe within 14m, you move 20% faster and gain Empower, dealing 15% more damage.

Spin around 4 times and attack all nearby foes in a 2.5m radius, dealing 50% weapon damage. You can move while spinning. This attack cannot backstab. Whirlwind can be block/dodge cancelled after the first spin. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
If you get hit while holding a great axe and are below 50% health, gain 40 stamina. (20s cooldown.)
Heavy attacks with a great axe pull foes closer to you.
If you hit a foe, gain an additional spin. Whirlwind's maximum number of spins is increased to 7.

Perform a fast, spinning attack that pulls targets within a 2.5m radius closer to you. Deals 110% weapon damage. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your great axe, hits with this ability inflict taunt for 4s. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Adds grit to great axe heavy attacks. Also grants 12% base damage reduction while grit is active. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Whirlwind's movement speed is increased by 100%.
After you pull a target, they are rooted for 0.4s, preventing movement during the duration. (1s cooldown on each target.)
Extends Maelstrom's pull range by 50%.

An upward swing dealing 25% weapon damage and projecting a powerful tear in reality that creates a vortex up to 10m away. The vortex pulls foes within 4m to its center and roots them for 1s. Foes within the vortex have their movement speed reduced by 60% due to the intense gravity. The collapsing vortex ends after 3s with a damaging burst dealing 100% weapon damage. (This effect cannot be dispelled.)
If you have 3 or more foes around you, increase base weapon damage by 15% for each nearby target. (Max 5 targets.)
Consumes all projectiles while Maelstrom is active.
When you block an attack with a great axe, gain Empower dealing 5% more damage for 5s. (Max 3 stacks.)
Increase burst damage by 10% for each foe caught in the vortex. (Max 5 targets.)
While holding a great axe, gain Empower dealing 10% damage when 3 or more foes are within 4m.
Maelstrom does an extra spin attack, pulling in foes and dealing 110% weapon damage. Additionally it gains grit during its startup. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
While holding a great axe, gain 20% armor when 3 or more foes are within 4m.
Allies gain 10% fortify while standing in your well. (Fortify increases armor.)
Great axe attacks grant a stacking Empower granting a 3% damage increase for 3s. (Max 10 stacks.)
Abilities and heavy attacks deal 20% more base damage to targets below 30% health.

Enter a berserk mode that increases all attack damage by 20% for 5s. Hitting a target will extend duration by 1s, up to a max duration of 12s. (Cooldown for this ability will not start until the mode ends.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your hatchet, activating this ability inflicts taunt for 8s to all enemies within 8m. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
After 3 successful light attacks or aimed throws against the same target, gain empower, granting a 20% base damage increase for 3s or until the next attack.
All cooldowns are reduced by 2% when hitting an enemy with an attack while your health is below 30%. (Max 5 hits per attack.)
While Berserk is active, your movement speed is increased by 13%.
After a successful heavy attack, gain empower, granting a 15% damage increase for the next 4 attacks within 5s.
Perform 4 fast attacks, each dealing 90% weapon damage. Raging Torrent can be block/dodge cancelled after the 1st attack.
Leap forward and strike twice. First Hit: 80% weapon damage and staggers. Second Hit: 130% weapon damage.
Increase base damage by 10% for every enemy within 5m. (Max 5 targets.)
While Berserk is active, all attacks gain 5% lifesteal.
Hitting a target with Raging Torrent grants haste, increasing movement speed by 15% for 6s.
If target is below 30% health, Feral Rush deals 20% more base damage.
Remove all stuns, slows, and roots from yourself when you activate Berserk.
Hitting a target with a heavy attack grants fortify, increasing armor by 15% for 3s.
Reactivate this ability or use basic attack at the end of Raging Torrent to perform a final attack that deals 120% weapon damage.
If Feral Rush hits a target in the back, it inflicts root, immobilizing the target for 2s.
Remove all bleed, burn, and poison effects from yourself if you hit an enemy while your health is below 30%. (Cooldown 60s.)
While Berserk is active, your attacks are uninterruptible and you can't be staggered.
When you receive lethal damage, avoid death and become invulnerable for 0.5s and restore 500 HP + 50% of your base health upon activation. (70s cooldown.)
Throw a hatchet up to 25m, dealing 110% weapon damage and applying 20% rend for 10s. (Rend reduces target's armor.)
Replaces block with an aimed throw that deals 100% weapon damage. Hold block to enter aimed stance and press basic attack to throw.
Increased critical hit chance of all melee attacks by 5%. Increased critical hit chance of all ranged attacks by 10%.
Rend duration increased by 4s if the target is further than 6m away.

Throw a hatchet up to 25m forward, dealing 115% weapon damage and inflicting 30% slow for 5s. (Slow reduces target's movement speed.) If standing still or moving backwards, you will dodge backwards obtaining momentary invulnerability. If moving sideways or forwards, you will continue moving unhindered.
Every third thrown hatchet hit is a guaranteed critical hit.
Critical hits with light attacks and aimed throws regenerate 10 stamina.
If Rending Throw hits a target with an active debuff, it deals an additional 20% base damage.
Thrown hatchets that hit targets with an active debuff reduce all hatchet ability cooldowns by 5%.
If Social Distancing hits a target with an active debuff, gain haste, increasing your movement speed by 15% for 6s.

Leap into the air and throw a hatchet that deals 150% weapon damage. This attack inflicts 30% disease and 10% weaken to your target for 10s. (Disease reduces target's incoming healing efficiency and outgoing healing efficiency by half the incoming value.) (Weaken reduces target's outgoing damage.)
Social Distancing hits apply a 1s root to targets.
All attacks deal 10% additional base damage to targets with an active debuff.
Increases the duration of disease and weaken by an additional 5s when hitting targets below 50% health.
If Rending Throw hits a target with an active debuff, its cooldown is reduced by 20%.
Thrown hatchets deal additional damage based on distance from the target. Up to a max of 25% additional base damage at 20m or greater.
Dodging within 2s of hitting a target with an ability consumes 25% less stamina.
Creates a 3m radius disease and weaken cloud on impact that lingers in place for 6s.

Hitting a target with a thrown hatchet extends the duration of all hatchet debuffs you applied on the target by 25%. All attacks deal 4% additional base damage per debuff on the target. (4 debuffs max.)

Perform a spin attack that deals 165% weapon damage to targets within a 3m radius, and applies a 30% slow for 3s. This ability has grit. (Slow reduces target's movement speed.) (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your spear, hits with this ability inflict taunt for 2s. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Deal 10% increased base damage on consecutive heavy attacks against a single target. (Max 3 stacks.)
Critical chance is increased by 10% when attacking targets that are at least 3m away.
Restore 25 stamina per target hit. (2 targets max.)
Successful heavy attacks reduce all spear cooldowns by 15%. (Max 1 reduction per attack.)
Your next dodge consumes 20% less stamina for 2s after a successful hit.
Sweep the target's legs, dealing 45% weapon damage and causing a knock down.
Stamina Regen Rate increased by 30% for 3s after a critical hit.
Throw your spear, dealing 80% weapon damage and staggering on hit.
Deal 25% increased base damage against knocked down targets.
Grit is now active during the attack. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Cyclone now pushes the target back 3m.
Targets are knocked down on hit.
Gain fortify after successful heavy attacks, increasing armor by 15% for 2s.
Reactivate this ability or use basic attack during Sweep to follow up with a heavy stab that deals 150% weapon damage.
Javelin deals 2.5% bonus damage per meter traveled. (Max 100%.)
Headshots reduce Javelin's cooldown by 25%.
Stamina regeneration rate is increased by 30% when your stamina is below 50%.
Deal 25% increased base damage while stamina is full.
Light attacks have a 5% increased critical chance.
Rush forward and skewer your target, dealing 125% weapon damage and applying bleed. Bleed deals 20% weapon damage every 1s for 10s.
All spear ability cooldowns are reduced by 10% on the second hit of the light attack chain. (Max 1 reduction per attack.)

Execute 3 quick piercing strikes that each deal 80% weapon damage and inflicts the target with 5% rend for 10s. (Max 3 stacks.) (Rend reduces target's armor.) Perforate can be block/dodge canceled after the 2nd attack.
The last hit of the light attack chain applies 30% slow for 3s to targets below 30% health. (Slow reduces target's movement speed.)
Skewer deals 20% increased base damage against targets that have full health.
Deal 15% increased base damage against targets with less than 30% health.
Deal 20% increased base damage against targets with active grit.
Gain empower if Skewer critical hits, increasing damage by 20% for 10s.

Use your spear to vault forward and kick your target, dealing 75% weapon damage and staggering them. Applies stun for 1.5s. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your spear, this ability inflicts taunt for 2s when it hits. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Rend increased to 10% per strike against targets above 50% health.
Bleed duration increased to 15s.
The first successful hit with an ability within 2s of dodging reduces all spear cooldowns by 20%. (Max 1 reduction per ability use.)
Gain empower after successful hits on targets below 50% health, increasing damage by 20% for 5s.
Each attack inflicts a stack of weaken to the target, reducing target's outgoing damage by 10% for 5s. (Max 3 stacks.)
Critical hits extend the duration of your spear debuffs by 20%.
Critical chance is increased by 15% when attacking a bleeding target.
Cooldowns for other spear abilities are reduced by 30% on successful hit. (Max 1 reduction per ability use.)
Deal 10% increased base damage for each debuff on your target. (Max 30%.)

Enter a posed stance and unleash a series of 5 quick thrust attacks with each strike dealing 60% weapon damage. Flurry can be cancelled at any time by dodging or by using another ability. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Reduce all rapier cooldowns by 1% on any hit. (Max 5 reductions per attack.)
Deal 10% more base damage when your target has greater than 50% health.
Each hit of Flurry does 25% more block damage.
Deal 5% more base damage to targets with a rapier bleed.

Flourish performs an attack dealing 60% weapon damage, staggering and pushing back enemies. Reactivating this ability or using basic attack at the end of Flourish will perform the follow up attack, Finish. Finish lunges forward dealing 120% direct weapon damage and consumes all rapier bleeds on any target hit dealing 110% of their damage immediately.

Slash so quickly that it extends the reach of your blade up to 5m. This strike deals 50% weapon damage and applies a bleed that will deal an additional 10% weapon damage per second for 10s. (Stacks up to 3 times and refreshes previous applications.)
Each hit of Flurry reduces its cooldown by 5%.
Gain grit on both Flourish and Finish. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Increase base damage from both middle swipe attacks in the light attack chain by 8%.
When applying the first bleed stack to an opponent, Tondo's cooldown is reduced by 10%.
Each hit of Flurry extends the rapier's bleed by 1s. (Future stacking applications of this extended bleed will also be extended to its longer duration.)
Any heavy attack on a bleeding enemy will extend their rapier bleeds by 2s. (Future stacking applications of this extended bleed will also be extended to its longer duration.)
Gain 20 stamina when successfully hitting a target with Finish.
If you hit only 1 target, even on a blocked hit, Tondo's cooldown is reduced by 25%.
The last hit of Flurry will inflict the enemy with a stack of bleed, dealing 10% weapon damage per second for 10s.
When Tondo's bleed ticks, reduce the cooldown of this ability by 9%. (Max 1 reduction per tick)
Increases initial hit base damage from Tondo by 100% if the target is already inflicted with rapier's bleed.
Finish deals 150% of the rapier's bleed damage instead of only 110%.
Leave the ground lunging forward for 10m in a stabbing motion and pierce through enemies dealing 145% weapon damage.
Deal 10% more base damage when your stamina is below 40%.
Gain 3 stamina on any hit.
Killing with this ability reduces its cooldown by 80%.

Perform a small, reliable sidestep in your current movement direction that cancels any current activity and provides momentary invulnerability. Light attacks made during Evade are performed exceptionally fast.
Deal 10% more base damage when your health is full.

Enter into a defensive stance for 1s. If struck during this ability, counter the attacker dealing 50% weapon damage, staggering and stunning them for 2s. You are briefly invulnerable upon a successful Riposte. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your rapier, activating this ability inflicts taunt for 4s to all foes within 5m. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
After performing Fleche, your next critical strike within 5s will deal 15% more base damage.
Critical strikes reduce all cooldowns by 5%. (0.26 cooldown.)
Individual successful light attacks reduce the cooldown of this ability by 25% each. (0.1s cooldown.)
If riposte successfully hits a target, gain empower, increasing damage by 10% for 3s.
Reactivating this ability or pressing basic attack at any time during Fleche will stop and perform a static, continuation attack dealing 115% damage.
Gain 12% haste for 3s after successfully evading through an enemy attack. (Haste increases movement speed.)
Gain 3% haste for 4s on rapier hits. Can stack up to 5 times. (Haste increases movement speed.)
Reduce the cooldown of other rapier abilities by 20% when landing a Riposte counter attack.
Gain 20 stamina after successfully evading through an enemy attack.
Evading forward gains 10% increased base damage on your next light attack. Ends on hit or after 1s.
Increase the stun from Riposte to 2.5s.
Deal 25% increased base damage on your next light or heavy attack after performing an ability. Ends on hit or after 3s.

Leap forward and strike the ground with arcane force dealing 130% weapon damage to all targets within 2.7m of the impact. Leave behind a hazardous area at the impact point that inflicts a stack of Impairment for 6s to all targets that enter. Impairment deals 10%weapon damage per second and weakens the target, reducing their base damage by 10%. (Max 3 stacks.) This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)

Abilities and Heavy attack hits against targets with less than 50% health, increase incoming healing by 5% and gain 7% haste to self for 3s. (Incoming healing increase scales with Focus, increasing its power to up to 20%.) (Haste increases movement speed.)

Grants Cooldown Reduction based on actions performed in different equip loads: •Heavy - 1% cooldown reduction when hit or blocking a hit. (0.5s cooldown.) •Medium - 5% cooldown reduction when dodging an attack. (1s cooldown.) •Light - 1% cooldown reduction when hitting a target. (1s cooldown.)
Smite hits reduce its own cooldown by 5% per target hit. (Max 5 targets.)
Hitting a target with a basic attack within 3s of using an ability will inflict exhaust, reducing stamina regen rate by 15% for 5s.

Swirl the flail above the player's head dealing 4 rapid hits of 75% weapon damage in a 3m radius around the player. After the first spin is completed, trigger a 3m blast of energy granting 10% empower for 5s to all allies inside the radius. Arcane Vortex can be block/dodge cancelled after the 2nd attack. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)

Grants a bonus based on what shield type is equipped: •Round Shield - Smite deals 20% more base weapon damage. •Kite Shield - Smite will now stagger targets hit, but damage is reduced to 90% weapon damage. •Tower Shield - Gain 30% fortify for 6s when smite is activated. (Fortify increases armor.)
Hitting targets 4 times with Arcane Vortex will inflict them with root, immobilizing them for 1s.

Being hit or blocking a hit from a melee attack while above 90% health inflicts a stack of Impairment for 6s on the attacker, dealing 10% weapon damage per second and inflicting weaken, reducing their base damage by 10%. (Max 3 stacks.) (5s cooldown.)

Drag the head of the flail against the ground causing an eruption of arcane energy in front of the player, dealing 120% weapon damage and inflicting two stacks of Impairment for 6s to all targets hit. Automatically follow up with an additional melee attack that deals 150% weapon damage. Impairment deals 10% weapon damage per second and inflicts weaken, reducing their base damage by 10%. (Max 3 stacks.)

Allies that enter the hazardous area gain Deflecting Frailty for 3s. Deflecting Frailty is a buff which, when receiving an attack, will inflict a stackable weakening effect to enemy attackers, reducing the enemy's damage dealt by 5% per stack for 5s. (Max 5 stacks.) Additionally while the effect is active, when allies are hit, they gain 15% lifesteal for 3s. (Deflecting Frailty scales with Focus, increasing its duration to up to 12 seconds.)

While at or below 50% health, all flail attacks grant 3% lifesteal while attacking targets. (Max 3 targets.) While above 50% health, all flail attacks extend the duration of damage over time effects on targets by 7%.
Hitting a target with Arcane Vortex grants a stacking haste on self, increasing movement speed by 5% for 7s. (Max 4 stacks.) Allies within the radius of the attack are granted a 20% haste for 5s.
Targets hit with the first attack of burst are slowed, reducing their movement speed by 40% for 3s.
When no allies are within 5m, all flail attacks deal 15% more base damage. When 1 or more allies are within 5m, they gain empower, increasing their damage dealt by 10%.

All allies within 3m of player during the Arcane Vortex are cleansed of crowd control status effects (Root, Stun, Slow) and are immune to them for 1 seconds. All allies inside are also healed for 65% weapon damage. (Healing scales exclusively with Focus.) (Crowd Control Immunity scales with Focus, increasing its duration to up to 5 seconds.)

The follow up attack triggers a chain that will bounce up to 4 times to allies within 6m of player, granting 130% of its total damage as health to each ally it chains to, and 35% of its total damage to self. (Healing scales exclusively with Focus.)
The follow up attack extends the duration of all debilitate status effects (Rend, Weaken, Exhaust, Disease) on the target by 30%.

While near 1 or more allies, grant passive healing to self and all allies that heals for 16% weapon damage every 3 seconds. Range of heal aura varies based on what equip load the player is: •Light - 5m radius area of effect. •Medium - 4m radius area of effect. •Heavy - 3m radius area of effect. (Healing scales exclusively with Focus.)

Sprint forward up to 10m. Upon reactivating the ability, pressing basic attack, or reaching the end of the sprint, leap forward up to an additional 3m and slam to the ground, dealing 30% weapon damage to targets in range of the flail during the leap and 80% weapon damage upon landing, staggering targets on impact. (Character collision is disabled while sprinting forward.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your Flail, this ability inflicts taunt for 6s when it hits. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
While at or above 50% health, reduce damage taken by 4%. While below 50% health, reduce the attackers stamina damage dealt while blocking by 10%.

The first target hit with a heavy attack within 3s of using an ability will cleanse 1 stack of any debuff from self, and will also inflict a stack of Impairment for 6s to the target hit, dealing 10% weapon damage per second and weakening them, reducing their base damage by 10%. (Max 3 stacks.)

Hitting a target with any of barrage's hits will grant a 30% fortify. The fortify has a 2s duration, and every hit extends the duration of the status effect by 2s to a max of 8s. (Moving through targets with the Bulldoze upgrade will also extend the duration of the effect.)
Swing the Flail forward latching onto a target dealing 50% weapon damage and knocking them to the ground.

Grants status effect duration modifications on self based on what shield type is equipped: •Round Shield - Increased base duration of all limited duration buffs on player by 10% •Kite Shield - Decrease base duration of damage over time and debilitating effects on player by 10% •Tower Shield - Decrease base duration of crowd control effects on player by 10%

Grants a bonus to Barrage based on what shield type is equipped: •Round Shield - Barrage hits for 30% more base weapon damage. •Kite Shield - Barrage hits inflict 20% slow for 4s. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)

Tripping a target applies a special debuff to the target lasting 3s. Allies that hit the affected enemy will reduce the duration of all damage over time effects on themselves by 10% per hit while active. (1s cooldown.)
While stamina is at or below 30%, activating an ability will grant 15 stamina. (5s cooldown.)

Perform a spinning leap then swing the flail down to strike targets, dealing 100% weapon damage. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)

Barrage can now block attacks while charging forward without consuming stamina, and will push all enemies moved through to the side. (This will also cause the targets moved through to be taunted if using a carnelian gem.)
Hitting weakened targets with trip will inflict 15% rend for 5s on the target, and granting 15% fortify on self for 5s. (Rend reduces target's armor.) (Fortify increases your armor.)

When blocking a hit, gain a 3s status effect, every blocked hit extends the duration of the status effect by 3s to a max of 9s, and while the effect is active, gain variable damage absorption based on current health percent and equip load: •Heavy - 5% absorption at full health increasing to a max of 20% mitigation as health decreases •Medium - 3% absorption at full health increasing to a max of 13% mitigation as health decreases •Light - 1% absorption at full health increasing to a max of 7% mitigation as health decreases

Stamina damage taken is reduced by 25% for 0.5s after activating block. Barrage's attack now triggers a 2.5m blast of energy around the target on hit, dealing 35% weapon damage to all nearby targets, and granting fortify to all allies within the radius, increasing armor by 20% for 8s.
Increase your max health by 25% of your physical armor rating while the flail is equipped. (This effect is active as long as the flail is equipped, even if the flail is sheathed.)
Reactivate this ability or use basic attack to add a follow up heavy attack that deals 145% weapon damage.

Upon hitting an enemy target, a nearby ally within 6m is selected and you become linked to them. While the connection is active, they gain empower, increasing their base damage by 15%, and you both gain damage absorption, reducing damage taken by 10% for 8s, or until players are more than 6m apart from each other. (This effect cannot be dispelled.)

Hitting a target with an ability while within 6m of an ally, applies a status effect linking yourself and a single ally to each other for 5s. While the effect is active the ally will only take 50% of the incoming damage and causing you to inherit 35% of the incoming damage they didn't take. (Cannot be applied to targets that already have this effect, or self if you already have the effect applied to an ally.)
If surrounded by 3 or more foes within 3m of you, gain 20% haste. (Haste increases movement speed.)
Headshots inflict rend reducing target's armor by 10% for 5s.
Shoot a barrage of arrows that covers a 4m radius area and deals 150% weapon damage. (This ability cannot headshot.)

Leap back 5m and shoot an arrow dealing 90% weapon damage to your target.

Rain of Arrows causes bleed, dealing 9% weapon damage per second for 12s.

Shoot an arrow that deals 50% weapon damage. On hit or land, this arrow creates 3m radius poison cloud that lasts 6s. Foes entering the cloud are poisoned and take 20% weapon damage per second for 7s. (This ability cannot headshot.)
After dodging with full stamina, gain 7% haste for 2s. (Haste increases movement speed.)
Evade Shot staggers and pushes the target back 2m.
Hitting a foe with a debuff grants 5 stamina.

Gain 7% haste for 5s when you swap to your bow. (Haste increases movement speed.) (Cooldown 10s.)

Direct hits against targets are more powerful and now deal 100% weapon damage.
Deal 10% more base damage to foes suffering from a debuff.

Gain Empower and deal 15% more damage for 5s after dodging.
Deal 10% more base damage to foes at least 10m away.
Shoot an arrow that deals 150% weapon damage and passes through targets. This attack has a range of 100m.

Fire an arrow that deals 50% weapon damage on hit, then explodes on impact dealing an additional 135% damage to all targets within a 2.5m radius.

Penetrating Shot deals 15% more base damage to targets 20m or more away.

Explosive Arrow direct hits inflict burn, dealing 8% weapon damage every second for 10s.

Deal 15% more base damage to any foe as long as you have not damaged them in the last 10s.
Increases the distance that arrows travel before being affected by gravity by 100%.
The third arrow of Rapid Shot deals 25% more base damage.
When you land a headshot, heal yourself for 10% of damage done.
Increases critical chance of bow shots by 10%.
Explosion damage increased to 170% weapon damage, but decreases the explosion radius to 1.25m.
When you land a headshot, deal 20% more damage.
Landing 2 headshots within 5s of each other halves the duration of the next reload.
Overload your musket with gun powder, causing the next shot to deal 160% weapon damage, and an additional 30% base damage to hostile AI targets. (Does not stack with Powder Burn.)
Increase musket base damage by 10% after aiming down sights for more than 2s.

Basic attack headshots reduce all musket ability cooldowns by 10%.
Shots fired before exiting stance increased to 5.
Musket shots deal 10% increased base damage to targets 20m or further away from the player. Also deal 7.5% increased base damage to targets within 40m.
Successful hits with a musket grant a stackable 2.5% base damage increase. This effect ends after more than 5s passes between shots. (Max 6 stacks.)
If 3 consecutive shots hit the same target, reduce all other musket cooldowns by 25%.

Grants a 15% damage increase to all headshots. If multiple targets are hit with a single musket attack, the next shot within 3s inflicts bleed to all targets the shot passes through, dealing 15% weapon damage every second for 5s.
A Powerful shot that deals 90% weapon damage, staggering the target and knocking back 5m. (Can be fired from hip or while aiming down sights.)
Deal 10% increased base damage to targets below 30% health.

Increases the stamina damage from standard shots dealt to enemies blocking with shields by 50%. Increases armor penetration against targets that are not blocking with a shield by 10%.
Deploy a trap that lasts for 30s. When triggered, it deals 25% weapon damage and causes its target to be rooted, immobilizing them for 3s.
Hitting a target with an active debuff grants empower, increasing your damage by 5% for 5s.
After a dodge, gain a 7% haste for 3s. (Haste increases movement speed.)

Gain an extra trap per cooldown, allowing 2 active traps to be placed in the world.

Increase musket base damage by 17% against targets affected by musket debuffs.

Fire 5 shots in a horizontal fan in front of you while pushing yourself backwards. Each shot will deal 45% weapon damage. (Every consecutive hit on the same target will deal 20% less damage than the previous hit.)

Increase the range of this attack from 12m to 16m.
Reloading gives you a 50% haste that lasts for 0.8s. (Haste increases movement speed.)

Shoot forward a four pronged claw attached to a chain from the muzzle. The projectile will travel up to 14m and cannot pull you upwards more than 3m. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your blunderbuss, this ability inflicts taunt for 4s when it hits. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)

Fire a large net out of the blunderbuss that deals 70% weapon damage and slows targets it hits by 40% for 3s. (Slow reduces target's movement speed.) Fire 4 additional pellets with each use of this ability.
Upon usage, restore 8 stamina every second for 10s.
Reloads give you a damage boost of 4% for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.)
If Net Shot hits a target, reduce its cooldown by 20%.
Each individual hit from this ability or from the blunderbuss primary fire will lower the cooldown of this ability by 1.5%.
The last shot loaded into the blunderbuss will do 15% increased base damage.
Landing a pellet, even if blocked, lowers the cooldown of this ability by 2% each.
The net now inflicts a 50% slow that degrades to normal move speed over 7s.
Fire a singular bomb down the center of the fan. This bomb will implant itself in the world and explode dealing 100% weapon damage in a 3m area after a 1s delay.
Successful pulls will automatically grant 1 loaded ammunition. If you currently have 2 loaded ammunition this will exceed the max cap and grant a third.
Successful hits within 3m grant fortify, increasing armor by 10% for 2s.
Net Shot's initial hit is reduced to 30% weapon damage. However, it now deals 35% additional weapon damage as bleeding each second for 3s.
The next shot fired within 6s after triggering an ability will have 8 pellets instead of 6.
Using an ability reduces all other ability cooldowns by 4%.

Shoot a grenade out of the blunderbuss that can bounce up to 4 times. (Each successive grenade hit against the same target deals 40% less base damage.)
Triggering an ability grants a 3% fortify for 10s. (Stacks up to 5 times.) (Fortify increases armor.)
Every pellet that is a headshot reduces all cooldowns by 0.5%.
Deal 25% increased base damage to targets greater than 50% health.

Load the blunderbuss with heavy canisters. If the target is 10m away or further, they will take 35% increased damage from the mortar.
Splitting Grenade explosions inflict burn on hit, dealing 10% weapon damage per second for 10s. (Stacks up to 3 times.)
Any grenade hit grants haste, increasing movement speed by 15% for 3s. (Multiple hits will refresh the duration.)
Each hit grants 7 stamina.
Deal 10% increased base damage to any target as long as you have not damaged them in the last 8s.
Gain an extra canister, you can now fire up to 4 shots.
Firing grants a 50% haste for 2s. (Haste increases movement speed.)
Direct base damage from abilities is increased by 15% if the victim is 10m or further away.

Blast immense wind out of the blunderbuss knocking down any target immediately in front of you. Blast Shot deals 50% weapon damage. This ability has grit. Whenever you take a hit and your health is below 50% gain fortify, increasing armor by 30% for 4s. (30s cooldown)
Holding onto 2 loaded ammunition for 2s after a reload will load a 3rd active ammunition.

Blast Shot applies 10% rend for 6s to all targets affected by this ability. (Rend reduces target's armor.)
Once every 30s, your next ability used will have its cooldown reduced by 50%.
Heavy attacks will now restore 5% of your max mana on hit. (Can only be triggered once every 0.5s.)
Heavy attacks reduce fire staff cooldowns by 7% on hit.
Cast forth a heavy fireball that deals 150% weapon damage in a 3m radius on impact, and an additional 20% base damage to hostile AI targets. Costs 25 mana.
While holding a fire staff and above 50% mana, gain 5% empower. (Empower increases damage.)

Summon down a 4.5m radius rain of meteors for 6s up to 20m away. Deals 100% weapon damage to targets upon entering the area, then deals an additional 50% weapon damage every 1s while targets remain inside. (This effect cannot be dispelled.) Costs 25 mana.
Fireball hits now apply a stack of smolder on targets, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.)
Invoke a burst of flames with a 2.5m radius at the target area that deals 155% weapon damage. Costs 15 mana.
Adds grit while casting Meteor Shower. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
Light and Heavy attacks inflict a stack of smolder on foes, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.)
Direct hits with Fireball restore 10% of your max mana and reduce your fire staff ability cooldowns by 7%.
Pillar of Fire deals 5% more base damage for each stack of smolder on the target, dealing 4.5% weapon damage each second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.)
Your fire staff abilities gain an extra 10% chance to critical strike.
Hitting a target that is inside meteor shower with a light or heavy attack will inflict smolder on targets, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.)
After not taking damage from an attack in the last 3s, gain Empower, granting 5% more damage.
Gain 15% of your max mana per enemy hit by Pillar of Fire.
Heavy attacks now trigger a 1m splash on impact, but the damage is reduced to 120%.
Meteor Shower now applies Disease, reducing the incoming healing by 10% and outgoing healing by 5% of all targets inside the area of effect.
While holding a fire staff, your critical strike damage is increased by 15%.

All attacks deal 10% increased base damage against targets with burn or smolder.

Create a 4m jet of flame from the staff dealing 50% weapon damage every second. Each hit inflicts a stack of smolder, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.) Costs 5 mana per second. (Mana does not regenerate while flamethrower is active.)

Cause a fiery explosion in a 3m radius area around yourself that deals 125% weapon damage and staggering your target. Inflicts smolder on struck foes, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.) This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Costs 22 mana. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your fire staff, hits with this ability inflict taunt for 3s. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
Dodging through an enemy melee attack inflicts a stack of smolder on foes, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks. 1s Cooldown.)
Increase the range of Flamethrower by 50%.

Incinerate hit inflict the target with 12% Weaken for 5s. (Weaken reduces target's outgoing damage.)
Applied smolder effects last 20% longer.
Increase the base damage of Flamethrower by 25%.

Dash forward up to 18m through targets dealing 130% weapon damage on hit. Passing through a target will inflict smolder on targets, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.) Costs 30 mana.
Cleanse 1 debuffs when hitting a target with incinerate. (Limit 1 activation per ability use.)
Flamethrower has no cooldown when cancelled. While Flamethrower is active, being staggered will activate a 6s cooldown and can only be reduced by conditional cooldown reduction.
Critical hits with fire staff abilities inflict a stack of smolder, dealing 4.5% weapon damage every half second for 6s. (Max 4 stacks.)

Restore 10% of your max mana whenever you critically hit a target. Restore 5% of your max mana when you hit a target with a heavy attack. (0.5s cooldown.)

Increase base damage of ice gauntlet ability critical hits by 10% while stamina is full.

Creates a trail of spikes that start from the player and go out in a straight line for 8m dealing 61% weapon damage. Cooldown for this ability reduced by 10% if an enemy is hit by the Mighty Spike.
Restore 15% of your mana whenever you hit with 3 consecutive light attacks.
Ice Storm mana cost is decreased by 80% while at full mana.
Increase duration of Wind Chill by 1s.
Mighty Spike base damage increased by 20% when hitting an enemy below 30% health.

Increases Ice Storm base damage by 10% for each enemy in Ice Storm. (Max 5 targets.)
Increase the base damage of the last 2m of the Wind Chill range by 25%.

Increases damage by 10% and adds stagger to the path of spikes. (Does not increase Mighty Spike damage.)

Blocking an attack with the ice gauntlet will convert mana to stamina. Converts 5 mana to 10 stamina.

Place a pylon that fires ice projectiles at enemies within 20m. Projectiles deal 75% weapon damage if they hit. Ice Pylon health will be 20% of players max health. Increase movement speed by 7% in a frosted area.
